core_categories: Wearable ECG Monitors; Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Devices; Patient Monitors; Wearable Devices (general); Medical Devices; IT / Industrial Distribution
specialty_focus: VitalConnect provides wireless wearable biosensor technology and remote patient monitoring (RPM) platforms for healthcare providers . Its regional branch supports medical facilities and patients by streaming real-time biometric data like ECG, heart rate, and respiration to cloud networks for inpatient and outpatient care. VitalConnect VitalConnect is a medical wearable technology principal that designs remote patient monitoring and biosensor platforms.
